# FG-DOC-0003

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_invalid_doctype_definition_is_doctype_definition_invalid` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 文書の型の定義（.forge/doctypes/ の YAML）を読めません。型の定義を直してください。その型の文書は検査できません。
- en: A document type definition (the YAML under .forge/doctypes/) cannot be read. Fix the definition; documents of that type cannot be checked.
- id: Definisi tipe dokumen (YAML di .forge/doctypes/) tidak dapat dibaca. Perbaiki definisinya; dokumen bertipe itu tidak dapat diperiksa.

## 原因 (cause)

`.forge/doctypes/<type>.yml` (forge_doc::doctype::parse_doctype, plan 13 §5, ADR-0026) is refused: over 64 KiB (doctype_too_large), not UTF-8 (doctype_not_utf8), its `name` is not its file name (doctype_name_not_filename), an unknown key (doctype_unknown_key), an unknown rule (doctype_rule_unknown), a pattern that is not a valid regular expression (doctype_pattern_invalid), an unknown value type (doctype_type_unknown), or another shape error (doctype_invalid). The definition's own problem is reported on the `.yml` file; every document of that type gets `doctype_invalid` (its type's rules cannot be applied). `forge/doc-lint` concludes `failure`; `gstn doc lint` exits 1 with this code; `gstn doc fmt` leaves the documents of that type as they are (their field and attribute order is the type's) and exits 1 with this code. Not a server fault.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

gstn doc lint .forge/doctypes --json lists the definition's problem with its line and rule; on the server the forge/doc-lint run's annotations name `.forge/doctypes/<type>.yml`.

## 対処 (fix)

Correct the definition at the listed line (plan 13 §5 describes the keys), then run gstn doc lint again.
